response.sql: SELECT o.observstation, o.lunarstage, COUNT(*) AS telescope_count FROM telescopes t JOIN observatories o ON t.observstation = o.observstation WHERE t.bandusagepct > 47.6 GROUP BY o.observstation, o.lunarstage ORDER BY telescope_count DESC LIMIT 10

assumptions.assumption: Each telescope is counted once per (station, lunarstage) group; since observstation is the primary key of observatories, each telescope matches at most one observatory row, so COUNT(*) equals the number of telescopes.
Ties in count at the top-10 cutoff are broken arbitrarily because the request specifies no secondary ordering.
